arxiv-2209-08600.title: GenPIP: In-Memory Acceleration of Genome Analysis via Tight Integration of Basecalling and Read Mapping
arxiv-2209-08600.creator: Haiyu Mao 1 Mohammed Alser 1 Mohammad Sadrosadati 1 Can Firtina 1 Akanksha Baranwal 1 Damla Senol Cali 2 Aditya Manglik 1 Nour Almadhoun Alserr 1 Onur Mutlu 1 1 ETH Zürich 2 Bionano Genomics
arxiv-2209-08600.description: Abstract Nanopore sequencing is a widely-used high-throughput genome sequencing technology that can sequence long fragments of a genome into raw electrical signals at low cost. Nanopore sequencing requires two computationally-costly processing steps for accurate downstream genome analysis. The first step, basecalling, translates the raw electrical signals into nucleotide bases (i.e., A, C, G, T).

arxiv-2311-15266.title: Unified construction of relativistic Hamiltonians
arxiv-2311-15266.creator: Wenjian Liu
arxiv-2311-15266.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Wenjian Liu. It is shown that four-component (4C), quasi-four-component (Q4C), and exact two-component (X2C) relativistic Hartree-Fock (HF) equations can be implemented in an unified manner, by making use of the atomic nature of the small components of molecular 4-spinors. A model density matrix approximation can first be invoked for the small-component charge/current density functions, which gives rise to a static, pre-molecular mean field (pmf) to be combined with the one-electron term.

arxiv-2312-01718.title: Type-II Seesaw Leptogenesis along the Ridge
arxiv-2312-01718.creator: Chengcheng Han 1,2, Zhanhong Lei 1, Jin Min Yang 3,4
arxiv-2312-01718.description: Abstract Type-II seesaw leptogenesis is a model that integrates inflation, baryon number asymmetry, and neutrino mass simultaneously. It employs the Affleck-Dine mechanism to generate lepton asymmetry, with the Higgs bosons serving as the inflaton. Previous studies assumed inflation to occur in a valley of the potential, employing the single-field approximation.

arxiv-2512-16200.title: Explicit and Non-asymptotic Query Complexities of Rank-Based Zeroth-order Algorithms on Smooth Functions
arxiv-2512-16200.creator: Haishan Ye
arxiv-2512-16200.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Haishan Ye. Rank-based zeroth-order (ZO) optimization—which relies only on the ordering of function evaluations—offers strong robustness to noise and monotone transformations, and underlies many successful algorithms such as CMA-ES, natural evolution strategies, and rank-based genetic algorithms. Despite its widespread use, the theoretical understanding of rank-based ZO methods remains limited: existing analyses provide only asymptotic insights and do not yield explicit convergence rates for algorithms selecting the top- k k directions.

pmc-10740750.title: The Safety and Efficacy of Phage Therapy for Infections in Cardiac and Peripheral Vascular Surgery: A Systematic Review
pmc-10740750.creator: Emily A. Simpson, Caitlin S. MacLeod, Helen J. Stacey, John Nagy, Joshua D. Jones
pmc-10740750.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). New approaches to managing infections in cardiac and peripheral vascular surgery are required to reduce costs to patients and healthcare providers. Bacteriophage (phage) therapy is a promising antimicrobial approach that has been recommended for consideration in antibiotic refractory cases. pmc-11525028.description: SummaryDespite advances in treatment, the prognosis of patients with osteosarcoma remains unsatisfactory, and searching for potential targets is imperative.
